title: Foodborne Illness
description: Plain-text reference on bacterial, viral, parasitic, and toxin causes, typical symptoms, and emergency warning signs. Covers home treatment and diet progression, the clean-separate-cook-chill rules, high-risk foods, food safety without refrigeration or clean water, and a food poisoning log.
shortDescription: Recognize food poisoning, know when it's an emergency, and treat it at home
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
